name: Dr Nik Gre Lassiter
bio: Composer and artist, and Lecturer in Composition and Fine Art at the University of Southampton. Developer of Endarkened Co-Composition.

name: Dr Lucy Lowe
bio: Social anthropologist working where reproductive justice and migrant justice meet.

name: Dr Dána-Ain Davis
bio: Author of “Cured”, the original story this work began from, and consulting scholar on the project’s research framing and archival work.

name: Deborah D.E.E.P. Mouton
bio: Poet and librettist for the opera, and lead of the project’s speculative storytelling workshop.

name: Princess Banda
bio: Socio-medical anthropologist researching how Black women’s experiences of obstetric anti-Blackness shape the risk of maternal death.

name: DW McCrary
bio: Filming the project for the documentary.

name: Professor Evelynn Hammonds
bio: Barbara Gutmann Rosenkrantz Professor of the History of Science and Professor of African and African American Studies. Her work examines how science, medicine and public health have shaped, and been shaped by, race, gender and politics.

name: Michelle Browder
bio: Artist and activist, creator of the Mothers of Gynecology monument to Anarcha, Lucy and Betsey, and founder of More Up Campus in Montgomery, Alabama.

name: More Up Campus
bio: Home of the Mothers of Gynecology monument, and host of the project’s research retreat in April 2026.
